lines.again: Read the note again. It tells you what to do.

highlightGiven.touch: The lit-up words tell which one. Read them again.
highlightGiven.ride: The lit-up words tell where to go. Read them again.
highlightGiven.choose: The lit-up words help. Read them again.

misconceptions.reading.ignoredNegation: Look for the word "not" in the note. It rules one out.
misconceptions.reading.choseFirstNamed: That one is named first. Read what the note says about each one.
misconceptions.reading.choseLastNamed: That one is named last. Read again to see which one the note means.
misconceptions.reading.wrongDirection: Check the direction word. Is it above or below?
misconceptions.reading.wentToOtherPlace: That place is in the note, but the job is somewhere else.
misconceptions.reading.usedNumberAsAnswer: That number is in the note, but it is not the floor. What does it count?
misconceptions.reading.followedWordOrder: Before and after tell what happens first, even when it is written second.
misconceptions.reading.mixedUpSides: Check left and right. Hold up your left hand to see.
misconceptions.reading.otherWordMeaning: That word can mean more than one thing. Which meaning fits this note?
misconceptions.reading.swappedCauseAndEffect: That is what happened. The word "because" tells why it happened.
misconceptions.reading.matchedWordsOnly: That shares a word with the note, but the note does not say it.

passage: The drill works fine.
The workbench is clean.
But the toolbox lid is stuck shut, and the crew needs the wrenches inside.
stuck-toolbox.ask: Touch the thing that needs fixing.
stuck-toolbox.clue: Two things in the note are fine. Find the one that is not fine.
stuck-toolbox.done: The lid pops open. Wrenches for the crew!

passage: It is too hot in the tower today!
Please start the fan on the left.
The other fan has a bent blade, so keep it off.
left-fan-only.clue: Find the word that says which side. Then hold up that hand to check.
left-fan-only.done: The left fan whirs. Cool air is on its way.

passage: The orange platform is closed for new paint.
The teal platform is closed too.
Only the yellow platform is open for jumping today.
open-platform.ask: Touch the platform that is open.
open-platform.clue: Cross out each platform that is closed. Which one is still open?
open-platform.done: The yellow platform is open. Time to jump!

passage: The big map shows the whole city.
The plans for every floor are kept in the drawers.
Lifty needs the plans for the new lift.
plans-in-drawers.ask: Touch where the plans are kept.
plans-in-drawers.clue: Find the sentence that tells where the plans are kept.
plans-in-drawers.done: The drawer slides out. The new lift plans are on top.

passage: The crane is resting today.
The blocks are already in the cart.
Please push the cart over to the new tower.
push-the-cart.clue: Find the word push in the note. Read what the crew wants pushed.
push-the-cart.done: The cart rolls away to the new tower.

passage: A box of new grow lights came to the Lobby today.
The lights are for the plants in Hydroponics.
Please take the box up there.
grow-lights.ask: Ride to where the lights go.
grow-lights.clue: Read where the lights are for. Then find that place in the directory.
grow-lights.done: Grow lights delivered. The plants will love them.

passage: Lifty, the tall ladder is not in Storage.
The crew left it in the Workshop, next to the drill.
ladder-not-in-storage.clue: Look for the word not. Then find where the crew left it in the directory.
ladder-not-in-storage.done: There is the tall ladder, right by the drill.

passage: Our test machine needs a new spring.
We are out of springs here on Floor 8.
Spare springs are kept at Platform Heights.
spare-springs.clue: Find where the spare springs are kept. Then look that place up in the directory.
spare-springs.done: Spare springs! The test machine can bounce again.

passage: The crew used the repair kit to fix the Archive door.
Then they left the kit two floors above the Archive.
kit-above-archive.clue: Find the Archive in the directory. Then count two floors up.
kit-above-archive.done: Found it! The repair kit was two floors up.

passage: The star crew wants to see the rings of a far planet tonight.
The rings are much too small to see with just your eyes.
rings-of-a-planet.ask: What will the crew look through? Touch it.
rings-of-a-planet.clue: What can make far, small things look big? Look at the things here.
rings-of-a-planet.done: The telescope is ready. Rings, here we come!

passage: Something in the Lobby has dry soil.
Its leaves are droopy and turning brown.
Lifty has a full watering can ready.
thirsty-plant.ask: Touch the thing that needs water.
thirsty-plant.clue: Which thing in the Lobby has soil and leaves?
thirsty-plant.done: Glug, glug. The plant perks up.

passage: One gear in here squeaks every time it turns.
It is not the big gear.
Oil the squeaky one.
squeaky-gear.ask: Touch the gear that needs oil.
squeaky-gear.clue: The word not rules out one gear. Which gear is still there?
squeaky-gear.done: A drop of oil, and the small gear turns without a squeak.

passage: A toy robot is lost on a floor between the Lobby and Storage.
It is not in the Workshop.
lost-toy-between.clue: Find the Lobby and Storage in the directory. Which floors are between them?
lost-toy-between.done: There it is, hiding in Utility!

passage: The golfers up at Rooftop Golf sent a message.
"Our ball bounced down the stairs and stopped two floors below us."
ball-down-two.clue: Us means the golfers. Find their floor in the directory, then count two floors down.
ball-down-two.done: Here is the golf ball, two floors below the roof.

passage: The painter and the plumber are on two different floors.
One is on Floor 12, and one is on Floor 13.
The plumber is not on Floor 13.
painter-and-plumber.clue: First work out where the plumber is. The painter is on the other floor.
painter-and-plumber.done: The painter waves a brush. Hello!

passage: Before anyone touches a fan, turn the power switch off.
Then clean the dust off the blades.
switch-before-fans.clue: Before tells what must happen first, even when it is written second.
switch-before-fans.done: Click. The power is off, so the fans are safe to clean.

passage: Fixing the shelf takes three steps.
First, take the drill off the workbench.
Next, drill two holes.
Last, put the drill back in the toolbox.
drill-first.ask: What does the crew pick up first? Touch it.
drill-first.clue: Find the first step. What does the crew take?
drill-first.done: Drill in hand. Two holes, and the shelf goes up.

passage: Before you putt the ball, look inside the hole.
A leaf might be blocking it, and the ball would bounce out.
check-the-hole.ask: What do you check first? Touch it.
check-the-hole.clue: Before tells what to do first. What do you look inside?
check-the-hole.done: No leaf. The hole is clear for a putt.

passage: Lifty has two jobs today.
After lunch, fix the lamp in the Test Lab.
Before lunch, oil the gears in the Machine Room.
jobs-before-lunch.ask: It is morning now. Ride to the first job.
jobs-before-lunch.clue: Morning comes before lunch. Find the job for before lunch, then find its place in the directory.
jobs-before-lunch.done: Gears oiled before lunch. The Test Lab can wait.

passage: The plants in Hydroponics are thirsty.
The crew can water them after Lifty brings the hose.
The hose is in Storage.
hose-first.ask: Where does Lifty go first? Ride there.
hose-first.clue: What must Lifty bring before the plants get water? Find where it is in the directory.
hose-first.done: Hose picked up. Next stop, the thirsty plants.

passage: Turn the crank to aim the telescope at the moon.
A crank is a handle that you turn around and around.
turn-the-crank.clue: Read what the note says the word means. Then look for that thing here.
turn-the-crank.done: Round and round. The telescope tilts up to the moon.

passage: The crane will hoist the blocks to the top of the tower.
To hoist means to lift something up high.
hoist-the-blocks.ask: Touch what will do the hoisting.
hoist-the-blocks.clue: Hoist means lift up high. Which thing here can lift blocks up high?
hoist-the-blocks.done: Up go the blocks, high on the hook.

passage: An antique is a very old thing that people keep safe because it is special.
The Lobby has one antique.
It is older than the whole tower.
lobby-antique.clue: An antique is very old and kept safe. What in the Lobby is kept safe?
lobby-antique.done: The old gear shines in its case, safe and sound.

passage: The printer is jammed again.
A sheet of paper is stuck inside, so no new messages can come out.
emphasis: no new messages can come out
jammed-printer.clue: Read the sentence after jammed. What is the paper doing?
jammed-printer.done: Stuck paper out. The printer hums again.

passage: The old map in the Archive is fragile.
If you pull on it, it could tear into pieces.
Always hold it gently with two hands.
fragile-map.clue: Read what could happen if you pull on it. That tells what fragile means.
fragile-map.done: Gently does it. The map stays in one piece.

passage: The radio has gone quiet.
It went quiet because the dish got bumped and now faces the other way.
Fix the cause, and the radio will talk again.
quiet-radio.ask: Touch the thing that caused the problem.
quiet-radio.clue: The word because tells the cause. Read what comes right after it.
quiet-radio.done: The dish turns back. The radio crackles, then talks!

passage: The windmill stopped turning.
It stopped because the banner blew loose and wrapped around the blades.
Take away the cause, and the windmill will spin again.
tangled-banner.ask: Touch what made the windmill stop.
tangled-banner.clue: Find the word because. The words after it tell what made the windmill stop.
tangled-banner.done: Banner untangled. The windmill spins again.

passage: The teal platform keeps wobbling.
It wobbles because a spring came loose.
Fix the cause, and the platform will hold still.
wobbly-platform.ask: Touch what made the platform wobble.
wobbly-platform.clue: Find the word because. The words after it tell the cause.
wobbly-platform.done: Spring fixed. The teal platform holds still.

passage: Lifty must put up a new sign by the lift.
The sign has to ask riders a question.
question-sign.clue: A question asks something. Look for the sign that ends with a question mark.
question-sign.done: The new sign asks: Where are you going?

passage: Lifty is writing a note for the night crew.
Every line of the note must be a whole sentence.
whole-sentence.ask: Which one is a whole sentence?
whole-sentence.clue: A whole sentence tells who or what, and what happened. Which card tells both?

options.fan-fixed: The fan on Floor 5 is fixed.

whole-sentence.done: Note sent. The night crew knows the fan works.

passage: The big box was too heavy for the cart.
So Lifty lifted it out and carried it alone.
box-or-cart.clue: The word it stands for a thing named before. Which thing was too heavy?
box-or-cart.done: Lifty carries the heavy box. The cart is fine.
